title: Prompt Studio
description: Turn a rough idea into a clean handoff for Flow/Veo or Suno. Build it locally, polish it with AI when useful, then copy exactly what the destination expects.
saveError: Your changes could not be saved. Keep this window open and retry.
actionError: The action could not be completed.
providerNeeded: Configure an AI provider in Settings first. Local drafting remains available.
blocked: Resolve the blocked checks before opening production.
ideaPlaceholder: A courier crosses a rain-slicked neon street before the last train leaves
topicPlaceholder: A midnight train carrying someone back home
manualHandoff: Copy this pack into the selected service. No video is generated in the app for this target.
approvedHandoff: Open production to review the request and approve its maximum charge before generating.
spatialWarning: Preview only. GPU rendering and exported maps are not qualified.
lyricsPlaceholder: Paste original lyrics, or use a clearly marked local suggestion
localLyricsSuggestion: Local lyrics are template suggestions. Edit them yourself or choose optional AI rewriting.
localFirst: Build and copy locally. AI enhancement is optional and never submits media generation.
emptyDescription: Describe one idea and build a local pack. Choose, edit and copy the result before deciding on production.
welcomeDescription: Create a video prompt or a song draft locally. You can configure AI and production later.
subject: Subject
labsDescription: Experimental tools are off by default. Only the listed capabilities are available.

labs.comfy: Connection diagnostics only. Production rendering is not integrated.
labs.live: Live microphone, playback and active-document directing are not qualified.
labs.lan: Two-device sessions, concurrent editing and network privacy are not qualified.
labs.spatial: Camera preview only. GPU rendering and exported maps are not qualified.
labs.foley: Reviewed cues, durable audio and playback are not qualified.
labs.fcpxml: External editor import is not qualified.

arenaDescription: Compare prompt packages from the same brief. This comparison does not rate generated video quality.
copyError: Copy failed. Try again or select and copy the text manually.
selectError: Target selection failed. Your current draft is preserved.

revision.title: Versions and comparison
revision.description: Save and restore project versions of both workspaces. Restore keeps a version of your current work.

revision.templateApplied: Template applied. Build a new pack.
revision.wait: Wait for the current save to finish.
revision.stale: The draft changed. Review the current version and try again.
revision.reviewDescription: Your draft stays unchanged until you accept. Review all three variants below.
revision.rejected: Proposal rejected. Your draft is unchanged.
revision.diffLegend: + Added · − Removed · Unmarked text is unchanged
revision.outdated: The brief changed. Build a new pack to update the output. Your previous edits are kept until then.
